title: MTEB-NL and E5-NL: Embedding Benchmark and Models for Dutch
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings related to religion. The models' performance on the 'IconclassClassification' task, which includes a 'Religion and Magic' category, is aggregated with other classification tasks, and no category-specific analysis is presented.

measurement_description: The benchmark includes the 'IconclassClassification' dataset, which measures a model's ability to classify the subject of artworks. One of the nine main categories for classification is 'Religion and Magic', which also includes 'Bible' as a theme.
